name: Demak Regency Social Affairs Office (Dinsos P2PA Demak)
description: Demak Regency Office of Social Affairs, Women's Empowerment and Child Protection: social aid, DTSEN registry, health insurance support, disability and elderly care, homelessness, disaster relief and violence against women and children (UPTD PPA).
name_id: Dinas Sosial, Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak Kabupaten Demak (Dinsos P2PA Demak)
description_id: Dinas Sosial, Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak Kabupaten Demak: bantuan sosial, pendaftaran DTSEN, bantuan jaminan kesehatan, layanan disabilitas dan lansia, tunawisma, bencana, serta kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak (UPTD PPA).

categories.label: Violence against women or children (KDRT, sexual violence)
Social aid not received or late (PKH, BPNT/Sembako, BLT)
DTSEN registry and eligibility (registration, status check, certificate of registration, data corrections)
Distribution schedule, pickup location (e-warong, post office) and PKH companion
Health and social insurance support (PBI-Pemda / UHC recommendation, BPJS for vulnerable workers)
Disability and elderly services (rehabilitation, assistive devices, home care)
Homeless people, beggars, street children and neglected people with mental illness (ODGJ, pasung)
Disaster relief (flood, tidal flood/rob, fire, social disaster)
Child marriage, adoption and childcare institutions (LKS)
Illegal levies or fraud in aid distribution

queues.protection: UPTD PPA (protection of women and children)
queues.slrt: SLRT / Puskesos (integrated referral service, DTSEN data)
queues.rehabsos: Social Rehabilitation Division (disability, elderly, homeless, ODGJ)
queues.bencana: Disaster victim protection (Social Protection & Security Division)
